entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.1 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the improved cross-file navigation (←/→ jump to the next file's first change, per-file cursor/scroll memory, n/N continuing across files) and the new change A/B · file X/Y header position indicator
  • FIX /rewind (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for very long conversations listing space-compacted messages as (empty message) and erroring when selected
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Windows MCP-server lifecycle fix for install/reinstall/uninstall, UTF-8 BOM support for plugin and MCP/hook config files, and the marketplace-install overwrite fix
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for relative skills:/plugins:/rules:/agents:/hooks: paths in Markdown custom agents, and subagents stuck on an error now showing Error: instead of Done
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted that timers, recurring jobs, and other background tools now appear here too, not just background shell commands
  • FIX queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix for "send-immediately" messages being silently queued whenever the agent had written or updated an artifact during the turn
  • FIX notifications (card-settings) — noted that it now alerts for pending questions, not just tool permission prompts
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for a server restart sometimes leaving it stopped with a "Failed to stop existing instances for reload" error
  • FIX GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that a dropped connection to the Gemini API now retries instead of failing the turn as cancelled

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.3.0 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG verbosity (card-settings) — noted the default changing from high to medium, per the release notes only; cli/reference still documents the old default and values
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted j/k now moving the line cursor like the arrow keys instead of jumping between files

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.17 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD Esc (card-keys) — noted the new dismissible announcement cards for model launches and service notices, dismissed permanently with Esc on an empty prompt
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the Windows sandbox no longer needing administrator rights, with Python/Git/npm working out of the box
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for .tiff images being misreported and silently converted to PNG

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.16 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /config (card-slash-core) — noted the ←/→ shortcut to cycle a highlighted setting's value without opening the dropdown
  • ADD /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted image-generation requests now running as a built-in image-generator subagent
  • CHG altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted improved resize performance in no-flicker (altscreen) mode for long conversations
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted improved mouse text selection with auto-scroll and streaming-safe selection, in both the altscreen view and this viewer
  • CHG queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix so "send-immediately" messages sent while others are queued go out together, in order, instead of joining the queue
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent stalling after a background command crashed or was killed, and for headless -p runs exiting too early
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — noted the fix for k in Vim Normal mode recalling command history instead of queued messages
  • FIX .agents/rules/*.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for manifests in a parent .agents/ directory being ignored when a session started in a subdirectory
  • FIX /skills (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the / menu listing skills the current agent does not enable

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.15 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /usage (card-slash-tools) — noted -p "/usage" printing quota reset times in the local time zone for interactive runs; piped and --json output stay UTC
  • CHG useG1Credits (card-settings) — noted the immediate "credits too low" error once both the plan quota and AI credits are exhausted, instead of a multi-minute retry
  • FIX CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty (card-env) — noted the SSH image-probe rework limiting image-capable terminals to Kitty/Ghostty over SSH, fixing garbled placeholders in WezTerm/Konsole and leftover escape codes in macOS Terminal.app
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — noted the Vim mode cursor fix for emoji and combining characters
  • FIX /resume (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for the search box wrapping long queries out of view
  • FIX ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for the agent being blocked from reading global rules/customization files, and for symlinked global rule files being added to context twice
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for MCP OAuth client registration responses using HTTP 200 instead of 201
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for large WebP images not being scaled down like PNG/JPEG

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.14 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD queuedMessages (card-settings) — new setting for follow-up messages during a turn (queue default, or send-immediately); unverified, absent from the cli/reference settings table
  • CHG --json-schema <schema> (card-cli) — noted that it now rejects plain text, bare type names, and missing schema files up front with exit code 1, instead of silently treating them as a string schema
  • CHG agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted remote-control start running the daemon as a background process on systemd-free Linux machines instead of failing
  • CHG /resume (card-slash-core) — noted faster loading for conversations with thousands of steps
  • FIX /resume (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for resuming a conversation with a missing history step overwriting its most recent steps

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.13 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the m hint now naming the content and mode it switches to, instead of a generic "toggle" label

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.12 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that a session using this key now stops immediately on an exhausted daily quota, spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits instead of retrying for several minutes; per-minute rate limits still retry
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted that bursts of scroll events are now coalesced before redrawing the full-screen view, cutting CPU use and scroll lag
  • FIX CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty (card-env) — promoted to verified; the release notes reconfirm it and fix the CLI sending its image-support probe through screen/tmux/Zellij, which had corrupted the terminal or tab title
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — noted the Vim mode fix for multibyte character navigation after r/f/F/t/T, fv/fV wrongly leaving Visual mode, and spurious empty undo steps from no-op edits
  • FIX verbosity (card-settings) — noted the fix for resuming a long conversation at medium/low verbosity lagging for many seconds while history replayed

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.11 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /effort (card-slash-core) — reasoning effort level gauge alongside --effort; unverified, absent from the cli/reference core slash command table
  • ADD /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — interactive Plugins Manager and inline install/enable/disable/list, confirmed on cli/reference; noted the change to unconfigured-plugin loading behavior
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the restored ASCII fallback for Mermaid/LaTeX in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal, and the Copy on Select fix so the terminal's own selection, copy, and Ctrl+C work again
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) and --agent <name> (card-cli) — noted the fix for project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found across Desktop-App/trusted workspaces, --agent runs, and headless runs

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.10 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG verbosity (card-settings) — noted a medium level between high and low, per the release notes only; not yet on cli/reference
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted background diagram pre-rendering, the zoom flicker fix, and the combined footer hints
  • CHG Esc (card-keys) — noted that it now closes an open suggestions dropdown before a second press interrupts the agent
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the agent asking to bypass the sandbox less often
  • FIX -p (card-cli) — noted the fix so a run that streams part of a response then errors exits with code 3 and an AGY_ERROR line instead of exit code 0
  • FIX agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the fix for the old Remote Control installer crash-looping after an upgrade

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.9 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the @<subagent> <message> syntax to message a subagent directly, with autocomplete
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the footer pan hint added for wide diagrams in the Kitty graphics viewer
  • CHG /rewind (card-slash-core) — noted relative step timestamps and auto-focus on the most recent step
  • CHG editorMode (card-settings) — noted Vim numeric count multipliers across Normal and Visual modes
  • FIX -p (card-cli) — noted the fix for daemon background processes lingering past run exit and hanging output-reading scripts
  • FIX --print-timeout <dur> (card-cli) — noted the fix so background tasks wait for the timeout deadline, capped at 30 minutes, instead of canceling ~5s after the agent went idle

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.8 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• FIX Ctrl+G (card-keys) — noted the fix for hanging with a Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal error; external editors now run against a real terminal stdout
  • FIX /voice (card-slash-tools) — noted dictation now auto-stops at 3 minutes 30 seconds instead of failing past 4 minutes

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.7 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted inline Kitty Graphics rendering for LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams, with ASCII fallback and Left/Right panning
  • CHG .agents/rules/*.md (card-skills) — noted the dedicated 20,000-token rule budget that keeps large rule sets from evicting skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.6 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /remote-control [on/off] (card-slash-tools) — session-scoped Remote Control for following and controlling the terminal session from another device; confirmed on cli/reference
  • ADD --remote-control (card-cli) — startup flag that opens the same connection; marked unverified until a newer agy --help confirms it
  • ADD Alt+F / Alt+B and Ctrl+W / Alt+Backspace / Alt+D (card-keys) — word-wise movement and deletion, which the release notes changed to stop at punctuation; unverified because the reference keybinding table omits them
  • CHG --print-timeout <dur> (card-cli) — headless runs no longer default to a 5-minute limit; the summary drops the stale default and a note records it
  • CHG -p (card-cli) — noted the structured AGY_ERROR: {...} stderr line and exit code 3 on agent or model API failures
  • CHG /model (card-slash-core) — noted that a model switch submitted mid-turn waits for the queued prompt instead of changing the running turn
  • CHG GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that headless sessions authenticated this way keep daemon background commands running after the turn
  • FIX /rewind (card-slash-core) — the note claimed rewind never touched files; the release notes describe workspace snapshot reverts, so it now says rewind restores the matching snapshot and records the 1.2.6 lookup fix

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.5 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • CHG /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted that an explicitly named background task keeps its name in notifications and the task list

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.4 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /skills (card-slash-tools) — noted the /skills reload subcommand for live skill and slash-command rediscovery
  • CHG /model (card-slash-core) — noted the inline argument autocomplete and the fuzzy search bar inside the picker
  • FIX hooks.json (card-hooks) — noted the fix for configurations silently dropped under customization token-budget truncation

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.3 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /copy (card-slash-tools) — noted the /copy btw subcommand that copies the active side-question response, plus argument ghost hints
  • FIX /hooks (card-slash-tools) — noted that the listing includes hooks bundled inside enabled plugins

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.2 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD card-keys — keybindings for global controls, prompt focus, navigation and tool confirmations, from cli/reference
  • ADD card-slash-core — session lifecycle and configuration/account slash commands, from cli/reference
  • ADD card-slash-tools — tools & tasks, reasoning/collaboration and utility slash commands, from cli/reference
  • ADD card-cli — agy flags and subcommands, verified against the installed 1.2.2 binary's --help
  • ADD card-settings — the 16 real settings.json keys, grouped by appearance, safety and account
  • ADD card-env — GEMINI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, from the install/auth docs
  • ADD card-skills — the GEMINI.md/.agents/rules tiers and Agent Skills discovery, from the rules and skills docs
  • ADD card-hooks — hooks.json lifecycle events, plugin manifests and MCP server config
  • DEL Removed 12 phantom slash commands absent from the vendor reference
    • /init, /compact, /plan, /status, /history, /mode, /effort, /reset, /goal, /learn, /browser, /schedule, /grill-me — a review of the prior draft found these did not exist on cli/reference.
